_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Zero of 39 recent 12h windows produced a ±2+ point move — this is a compressed coil with no statistical edge in either direction, and the macro divergences prevent trusting the bullish analog enough to call a breakout.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — Analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; Narrative implies bullish resolution but does not commit to a directional call, so the consensus defaults to the analyst's coil read
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.0005% with fear_greed holding 25-32 and btc_momentum_30d rolling over toward 45 — signals Denial-to-Anxiety drift with positioning reset
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows sustain above 90 with btc_momentum_30d clearing 65 and MVRV z-score lifting above 35 — breaks the macro-stress ceiling and forces Hope recognition; alternatively VIX spiking above 20 with DXY breaking 101 flips to Anxiety down-leg
